articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs attract $1.08 billion in 3 days but it may not be enough for a steep rally
articles.description: Past steep rallies ran on about $235 million a day of net inflows into ETFs. The funds are yet to match that pace, according to data analyzed by CoinDesk.

articles.title: XRP Ledger bug fix moved to November after validator support dipped for two hours
articles.description: The fix lost its two-week countdown less than two days from the finish after support slipped to 26 of 35 validators. It’s now back at 31.

articles.title: U.S. pulls diplomats from Saudi Arabia as it reportedly readies Iran strikes after midterms
articles.description: The U.S. ordered non-emergency staff out of Saudi Arabia after Houthi strikes on an airport and an oil field, reviving fears of a widening regional conflict.

articles.title: China's stock market sinks into bear territory as CSI 300 extends 10-week rout
articles.description: China's benchmark CSI 300 index has entered bear-market territory, falling 20% from its June peak, as a prolonged selloff in mainland equities deepens.

articles.title: Bitcoin gives back its run at $85,000 as Tesla and Meta fail to calm AI nerves
articles.description: BTC broke through its $84,000 ceiling late Wednesday, then slid back to the $82,500 support analysts are watching as tech futures fell.

articles.title: Sovereign wealth funds' China and Hong Kong investments surge 190% after a bruising slump
articles.description: Sovereign wealth funds are pouring billions of dollars back into China after a sharp investment slump.

articles.title: Bank of Korea holds rates after President Lee calls for boosting housing supply
articles.description: Economists polled by Reuters had forecast the Bank of Korea to hold rates.

articles.title: Southeast Asia is hungry for AI — and the money isn't just in subscriptions
articles.description: Southeast Asia's rapid AI adoption is creating business opportunities beyond paid consumer subscriptions, a partner at Bain & Company, told CNBC.

articles.title: James Talarico fires back at Elon Musk in Texas Senate race feud
articles.description: Musk in September donated $158 million to a Republican Super PAC, which sent that cash to a PAC backing GOP Senate nominee Ken Paxton, Talarico's opponent.

articles.title: Critical web security flaws spark global alarm as Google, OpenAI and Amazon respond
articles.description: Critical PHP security flaws trigger global warnings as Google, OpenAI and Amazon respond to potential cyber threats.

articles.title: Meta put out an ambitious roadmap to Muse monetization after strong quarter and guide
articles.description: Investors liked what they saw.

articles.title: PHP Foundation admits ‘structural failure’ delayed critical security fix
articles.description: Government websites and online services were disrupted after concerns about a PHP bug that could allow attackers to take control of vulnerable servers.

articles.title: Inside India newsletter: Asia’s hottest data center market aims to quell concerns over water and power use
articles.description: India is grappling with growing public anger against data centers that pose a threat to its ambitions to host the whole world's data.

articles.title: Tesla beats on earnings and sales even as auto revenue declines
articles.description: Tesla reported better-than-expected third-quarter results.

articles.title: CoreWeave’s market confidence erodes as bond yields spike and stock sinks
articles.description: CoreWeave shares are down 29% in October, and the spreads in its credit default swaps are widening.

articles.title: IBM beats on top and bottom lines as CEO Krishna touts 'Super Intelligence' traction
articles.description: CEO Arvind Krishna indicated that IBM is helping clients in artificial intelligence.

articles.title: American Bankers Association: OCC’s GENIUS rules ‘undermine’ US Congress
articles.description: Banking advocacy organizations are pushing back against the OCC’s finalized rules on a stablecoin law, arguing against changes to provisions on yield.

articles.title: Trump denies ordering Starlink slowdown in Ukraine, says he doesn't know who did
articles.description: Asked if Elon Musk ordered the slowdown, Trump said, "I don't know who did it, but I was not involved."

articles.title: New Mexico AG lawsuit accuses Epstein's attorney and accountant of facilitating sex trafficking
articles.description: Darren Indyke and Richard Kahn allegedly helped finance and conceal Epstein's sex trafficking, which included abuse at his Zorro Ranch, a lawsuit says.

articles.title: Ken Griffin Says AI Is 'Almost Certainly' in a Bubble—And Compares GPUs to Airline Seats
articles.description: Citadel's founder says investors are almost certainly in an AI bubble, warns a chip glut could crash prices like empty airline seats, yet expects the survivors to lead for decades.
